question: Do the confirmed final-query L11H1/H3 and L15H5 auxiliary writes use the same native-pattern value-transport operation as L9H1/H4?

authority.finding: Final query supplies 99.0/99.6% of auxiliary behavior and 99.6/99.6% of its Q8 norm; all other destinations are negligible.

frozen_design.population: The same 27 jointly capable v10 A1/A2 rows.
frozen_design.contexts: For each auxiliary layer, compare native-base attention terms to terms under the MLP8 complement with L9H1/H4 clamped to base. L11 and L15 selected responses are installed at every causal destination in causal order; the released destination atlas establishes that the final query supplies more than 99% of the effect.
frozen_design.factor_identity: For each selected head, causal destination, and causal source, delta_response = (P_changed-P_base)V_base + P_base(V_changed-V_base) + (P_changed-P_base)(V_changed-V_base).
frozen_design.arms: All eight subsets of pattern, value, and interaction, installed jointly at L11H1/H3 and L15H5. Empty must reproduce the five-head clamp; complete must reproduce the L9H1/H4-only clamp.

predictions.pred_a_authority_factor_complete_replay_: Hashes, native reconstruction, raw factor closure, empty/five and complete/core replay, finite metrics, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_base_pattern_value_transport_is_d: Value-only retains at least 75% auxiliary behavior and 75% auxiliary Q8 norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_pattern_change_is_secondary: Pattern-only carries at most 25% absolute behavior and 25% Q8 norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_pattern_value_interaction_is_seco: Interaction-only carries at most 20% absolute behavior and 20% Q8 norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_shared_operation_test: No fit, gradients, head selection, destination selection, rank search, or model update.

decision: Screen licenses source-region decomposition and literal c_v/c_proj compilation for both auxiliary layers using a shared value-transport primitive. Null requires layer-specific factor analysis before compilation.
